name: Recite Practice
改动即时生效: Changes apply instantly, no save needed
标语: Read a good passage, write your own
皮肤Pro提示: Skins are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock all skins
装饰Pro提示: Lace & decorations are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock
拆分Pro提示: AI splitting is a Pro feature. Activate to use it (AI grading stays free)
判卷小宠物: Grading Pet (perches on the float bar)
宠物Pro提示: This is a Pro mascot. Activate to unlock.
背景Pro提示: This background is a Pro visual. Activate to unlock all backgrounds
第三方主题背景提示: A third-party theme is in use: built-in backgrounds may not fully match its palette. This does not affect functionality.
纹理浓淡说明: Adjust paper grain intensity. 50 is the factory baseline; 0 is plain paper.
写作竖线说明: The vertical marker left of your writing during practice (write zones and your sentences). Turn off to rely on text color and the soft background only.
写位底色浓度说明: How deeply empty write slots are tinted. 100 is the factory baseline; 0 disables the tint.
题目标题级别说明: Which heading level (1-6) renders each question title in the extract & compare docs. Default H6 (compact); rebuild the doc (Rewrite / Compare) to apply.
背景图片类型不支持: Only png / jpg / webp / gif images are supported
背景图片过大: Image exceeds 8MB — please compress it first
花边入口说明: The "Block Frill" entry in the Plugins submenu when you right-click a block (five decorative frill styles, Pro visual). Turning it off only hides the entry; blocks that already have a frill keep rendering.
浮条Pro提示: Float bar skins are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock all styles
加闪卡提示: Add this practice document as one flashcard to the quick deck, reviewed alongside digest cards
已加入闪卡: Added to flashcards (quick deck) — open SiYuan flashcard review to see it
浮条收起: Hide the recite bar until you switch documents
AI判卷提示: Grade instantly with the AI configured in SiYuan (Settings → AI); overwrites the previous review
未配置AI内容: No usable AI config found. Please set up and enable a model provider (API key) in SiYuan Settings → AI, save, then try again.
AI请求失败: AI request failed. Check network and API key, then retry
AI响应中断: AI response interrupted. Document restored, please retry
判卷完成: AI review finished and appended to the end
复制提示词提示: Copy the grading prompt, optionally opening DeepSeek/Doubao/Tongyi in browser to paste
已复制选网页: Prompt copied — click a menu item to open a web AI chat and paste
默写查错提示: Character-by-character diff against the original: wrong/extra in red strikethrough, missed in green underline. Popup only — nothing written to the doc
查错·完美: Perfect match — not a single difference 🎉
查错·先写提示: No recitation in the extract doc yet — write first, then check
查错·联想说明: Association prompt · free writing, no verbatim diff
查错·纯联想: Association prompts have no verbatim diff — hit “AI Grade” for creative feedback
AI拆分提示: AI reads the whole piece and auto-inserts anchor notes at narrative beats (uses your SiYuan AI config and quota); re-running replaces old AI anchors, handwritten notes stay
AI返回异常: AI response could not be parsed, please retry
拆分失败: Failed to insert anchor blocks, please retry
